user: How do Velorians and Celbians welcome newcomers to their communities?

templates.neutral: gather in communal spaces to greet newcomers with warm smiles and friendly gestures, share traditional meals that showcase local flavors and recipes, introduce them to community members who offer guidance and support, and provide assistance in settling into their new environment with helpful resources and information
templates.animalistic: roam together in welcoming packs to greet newcomers with excited vocalizations and playful nudges, share communal feasts that feature hunted and gathered foods, introduce them to the dominant members who assert their role in the hierarchy, and offer support in establishing their den by marking territory with shared scents and signals
templates.mechanistic: assemble in designated areas to orient newcomers with systematic briefings and structured data sharing, distribute meals that are planned according to nutritional guidelines and resource availability, integrate them into social networks through formal introductions that optimize connectivity, and facilitate their transition into the community by processing their needs through established support channels
